projection_indexed_help: Present and up to date in the current index session
projection_pending_help: Published, but missing from the current index or present with a stale content
projection_orphan_help: Still present in the current index while no longer published
projection_none_help: Draft, not meant to be projected into the index

entries-board.title: Knowledge base
entries-board.no_entry_found: No entry in the knowledge base
entries-board.no_entry_message: Create a first question / answer entry to feed the bot vector store.
entries-board.no_matching_entry_message: Change or reset the filters to broaden the search.
entries-board.create_index_title: Create the index from the knowledge base
entries-board.create_index_subtitle: Tock will create a new index session, project the published entries into it and update the bot RAG configuration.

sync-banner.no_index_title: No vector index is configured for this bot
sync-banner.no_index_message: Tock can create the index and project the {{published}} published entry(ies) into it, with no external ingestion tool.
sync-banner.out_of_sync_title: The index does not reflect the knowledge base
sync-banner.orphan_count: {{count}} orphan entry(ies) still present in the index
sync-banner.unknown_embedding_model_warning: The embedding model of this index could not be determined. If entries are embedded with a different model of the same dimension, they will be written without error but will remain unusable.
sync-banner.create_index_tooltip: Create an index session from the published entries
sync-banner.embedding_warning_message: Published entries are indexed normally, but the embedding model of this index could not be verified.
sync-banner.repair_tooltip: Reproject published entries and clean up orphan rows. Creations, edits and unpublications are already applied.

entry-detail.title_placeholder: The information, phrased the way a user would
entry-detail.title_help: This identifies the entry and is what matching relies on first. A question, but just as well a statement or a topic.
entry-detail.hints_help: Optional. Other phrasings, synonyms, keywords: anything that helps the entry be found. They are indexed along with the content. A few are enough, a long list dilutes the search.
entry-detail.hint_placeholder: Another phrasing, a synonym, a keyword
entry-detail.content_placeholder: The content of the entry, in markdown
entry-detail.content_help: Plain markdown. This text is indexed and handed as is to the model, which will rephrase it in its answer.
entry-detail.source_url_help: Optional. An http(s) URL is used as the source cited in the bot answer.
entry-detail.source_url_invalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
entry-detail.status_draft_help: A draft is not indexed and has no effect on the bot answers.
entry-detail.status_published_help: On save, the entry is indexed immediately and can be used in the bot answers.
entry-detail.save_tooltip_create_draft: Saves a draft. Nothing reaches the bot until the entry is published.
entry-detail.save_tooltip_create_published: Creates the entry and indexes it immediately: the bot can use it from the next question on.
entry-detail.save_tooltip_publish: Publishes the entry and indexes it immediately: the bot can use it from the next question on.
entry-detail.save_tooltip_unpublish: Withdraws the entry from the bot immediately: it will no longer be used in answers, but is kept here as a draft.
entry-detail.save_tooltip_update_published: Updates the entry and reindexes immediately: the bot uses the new version from the next question on.
entry-detail.save_tooltip_update_draft: Updates the draft. Nothing reaches the bot until the entry is published.
entry-detail.save_tooltip_no_index: No index is configured for this bot: the entry will be saved but cannot be used in answers.
entry-detail.saved_create_draft: Draft created. It is not used by the bot.
entry-detail.saved_create_published: Entry created and published: the bot can now use it.
entry-detail.saved_publish: Entry published: the bot can now use it.
entry-detail.saved_unpublish: Entry unpublished: the bot will no longer use it. It is kept here as a draft.
entry-detail.saved_update_published: Entry updated: the bot uses the new version.
entry-detail.saved_update_draft: Draft saved. It is not used by the bot.
entry-detail.saved_no_index: Entry saved, but no index is configured for this bot: it cannot be used in answers yet.
entry-detail.delete_dialog_subtitle_indexed: "{{title}}" will be permanently deleted, and the bot will immediately stop using it in its answers. This cannot be undone.
entry-detail.delete_dialog_subtitle_draft: "{{title}}" will be permanently deleted. It is not used by the bot today, its answers will not change. This cannot be undone.

retrieval-test.title: Test retrieval
retrieval-test.help: Checks whether this entry would be retrieved for a given question, and at what rank. Without it, tuning an entry is guesswork.
retrieval-test.question_placeholder: A question as a user would ask it
retrieval-test.unavailable_no_index: No index is configured for this bot: retrieval cannot be tested.
retrieval-test.unavailable_not_saved: Save the entry to test its retrieval.
retrieval-test.draft_notice: This entry is a draft: it is not in the index and will not be retrieved.
retrieval-test.dirty_notice: Unsaved changes: the test runs against the currently indexed version.
retrieval-test.verdict_not_retrieved: Entry not retrieved: it is outside the {{k}} passages handed to the model and will have no effect on the answer.
retrieval-test.result_footnote: These are the passages the retriever would hand to the model. Being retrieved does not guarantee the model will rely on the passage.
retrieval-test.open_in_diagnostic_tooltip: Open in the search diagnostic with the entry already pinned, to vary k, the search mode or compression

import.title: Import entries
import.help: Drop a JSON file. Two formats are accepted, and only those: a file matching neither is refused rather than interpreted at best effort.
import.format_kb: Tock knowledge base export, to move entries between environments.
import.format_faq: Tock FAQ JSON export, to carry over existing content when going live.
import.import_tooltip: Import entries from a JSON file
import.error_unknown_format: matches neither a knowledge base export nor a FAQ export.
import.locale_help: This FAQ file holds several languages. A knowledge base entry carries only one: the others will be ignored.
import.faq_disabled_tooltip: This FAQ was disabled, which matches the entries historically diverted to feed the corpus
import.drafts_notice: Imported entries are drafts: nothing has been written to the index.
import.published_notice: Imported entries have been published and indexed.
import.issue_no_content_for_locale: no content in the chosen language
